title: fix(plugin-auth)!: under local sign-in off, the last identity provider is the last way in; the direct sign-in door keeps ?redirect=
body:
Part of #33358

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowed: with direct sign-in on and its local sign-in path `off` (`directSignIn.localSignIn: 'off'`, or `OS_AUTH_DIRECT_SIGN_IN_LOCAL_PATH=off`), `POST /api/v1/auth/sso/delete-provider` on the last identity provider answers `409 DELETE_RESTRICTED` and deletes nothing while email and password is switched on, where it deleted the row; email and password, and phone sign-in, no longer count as a way in there, because the sign-in page does not offer them. Widened: module exports (not on the package entry) `pageOffersLocalSignIn`, `pageOffersEmailPassword` and `carriedRedirect`, an optional `localSignIn` on `SignInMethodConfigView.features`, and an `asThePageOffers` option on `otherSignInMethods`; the refusal under `off` answers with a new message, the copy key `enterpriseSsoLocalOff`, in all 11 locales.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches direct sign-in, the provider delete or the boot report; `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` gains the rule in this change.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：直接登录把本地登录路径设为 `off` 时，登录页不再显示邮箱/密码和手机登录；现在"保留最后一种登录方式"的检查也不再把它们算作登录方式，所以删除最后一个身份提供方会被拒绝（409），启动时也会报错提示。另外，直接登录入口把人送回登录页时（身份提供方报错、被限流、无法发起）会带上原来的 `?redirect=`。
- **为什么改**：之前在 `off` 下删掉最后一个身份提供方会成功，随后登录页只显示"没有可用的登录方式"，所有人（包括管理员）被锁在外面；深链接用户在出错后重试会落到首页而不是原来要去的页面。
- **风险与回滚**：只影响开启直接登录且本地登录路径为 `off` 的自托管部署（之前允许的删除现在被拒，属于收窄，已标 BREAKING）；`hidden`（默认）和未开启直接登录的部署行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sign-in-method-floor.ts`（`ssoProviderDeleteRefusal` 与 `resolveNoSignInMethodReport` 两处判断）、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/direct-sign-in.ts`（`carriedRedirect` 与两个落地地址）、`.changeset/33358-local-sign-in-off-floor.md`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/sign-in-method-floor.test.ts src/direct-sign-in.test.ts`，预期全部通过，其中包含 `under the local sign-in path off, deleting the last provider is refused` 与 `keeps the page's ?redirect=` 几条。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Items covered from #33358: **1** (N7, the sign-in method floor and the boot report), **3** (the provider-error return address keeps `?redirect=`) and **4** (the rate-limited landing keeps `?redirect=`). Items **2** (the IP allow-list landing on the direct sign-in door) and **5** (the N13 sign-out note) remain on the card for a later round.

**Item 1 — the floor counts what the sign-in page offers.** The page decides what it draws from `features.localSignIn`, which `getPublicConfig()` serves only while direct sign-in is on: under `'off'` `LoginForm` draws no email and password and no phone sign-in. The floor now reads the same served value with the same predicate (`pageOffersLocalSignIn(config)` is `config.features?.localSignIn !== 'off'`, exactly the page's test), so:

- `ssoProviderDeleteRefusal` (the `/sso/delete-provider` door) and `resolveNoSignInMethodReport` (the boot report) count email and password only when it is on **and** the page offers it (`pageOffersEmailPassword`), and count phone sign-in only when the page offers it (`otherSignInMethods(..., { asThePageOffers: true })`).
- The 409 under `off` carries a new localized copy, `enterpriseSsoLocalOff` (11 locales), chosen by `!pageOffersLocalSignIn(config)` whatever email and password says, because the existing copy's remedy, "turn email and password sign-in back on", draws nothing under `off`. Its remedy: register another identity provider, set up another sign-in method, or set the local sign-in path back to `hidden` with email and password sign-in on.
- The boot report under `off` (chosen the same way) names `OS_AUTH_DIRECT_SIGN_IN_LOCAL_PATH=hidden` as the recovery, plus `OS_AUTH_EMAIL_PASSWORD_ENABLED=true` when email and password is off too; it no longer says "no phone-number sign-in" there.

Phone sign-in is included as a bounded in-place fix: it is the same defect class (a local way in the page does not draw under `off`, counted anyway), a mechanical change in the same file, held by this claim, in the same gate family. Without it a deployment with phone sign-in on and `off` would pass the same delete and reach the same "No sign-in method is available" page.

**Items 3 and 4 — the door's landings keep `?redirect=`.** The Console hands the door its own path and query as `callbackURL` (for example `/_console/login?redirect=%2Fapps%2Fcrm&direct=returned`). `carriedRedirect(kept)` reads `redirect` from the already-kept return path, carries it only when it is sent once and is itself a kept return path (`keptReturnPath`, the door's existing same-origin rule), and both landings now use it: the `errorCallbackURL` handed to the vendor (`/login?redirect=...`; better-auth appends its `error` to it) and the door's own landing (`/login?error=...&redirect=...`, the rate-limited one and the unavailable one alike). With no `?redirect=`, or a foreign one, both are the bare page exactly as before.

Docs: `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` says both rules, names the two checks this PR changes (the provider delete and the boot report, email and password and phone sign-in alike), and says the settings save is still open on #33358.

## Tests

- `src/sign-in-method-floor.test.ts`, the composition (real kernel, sqlite, AuthPlugin and settings): under `directSignIn: { localSignIn: 'off' }` with email and password on, deleting the last provider answers 409 `DELETE_RESTRICTED` with `enterpriseSsoLocalOff` and the row stays; CONTROL: under `hidden` the same delete is 200 and the row is gone; a boot under `off` with no provider reports `no_sign_in_method_at_boot` naming `OS_AUTH_DIRECT_SIGN_IN_LOCAL_PATH=hidden`; CONTROL: the same boot under `hidden` says nothing.
- Same file, the judge over a fake: under `off`, neither email and password nor phone sign-in counts (delete refused, boot report said); CONTROL under `hidden`: both count as before; phone alone under `off` with email and password off is refused with `enterpriseSsoLocalOff` and its boot report names both settings without "no phone-number sign-in"; CONTROL: email and password off under `hidden` keeps the `enterpriseSso` copy and the `OS_AUTH_EMAIL_PASSWORD_ENABLED=true` report. Composition: a boot under `off` with email and password off names `OS_AUTH_DIRECT_SIGN_IN_LOCAL_PATH=hidden and OS_AUTH_EMAIL_PASSWORD_ENABLED=true`.
- `src/direct-sign-in.test.ts`: the vendor's `errorCallbackURL` keeps `?redirect=`; the rate-limited landing keeps it; CONTROL: with no `?redirect=` both landings are the bare page, as before; a foreign `?redirect=` is dropped and the landings are the bare page, pinned over every spelling in `FOREIGN_RETURN_PATHS` (24: absolute, protocol-relative, backslash, `javascript:`, control characters, percent-encoded forms, `/..//`, empty, over-long).

## Acceptance notes

- The card names the setting `OS_AUTH_LOCAL_SIGN_IN=off`; the variable in the code is `OS_AUTH_DIRECT_SIGN_IN_LOCAL_PATH` (`directSignIn.localSignIn`). The premise holds otherwise.
- Not changed here, same family: the auth **settings save** door (`signInMethodFloorPredicate`) still counts email and password on under `off`, so under `off` a save that switches off Google as the last social provider passes. Its refusal copy speaks of turning email and password back on, so a fix there needs its own copy. Reported to the seat for the card rather than widened here.
- Not changed here: the 503 copy (`enterpriseSsoUnverified`) still says "with email and password off"; under `off` with email and password on it is slightly inaccurate, but it is still the right refusal.
